params.body:
`settings` is MyISAM, so `DatabaseTransactions` does not roll back the `background_image` and `background_light_image` rows that two tests in `WhiteIsTheDefaultBackgroundTest` create. Every run left four rows behind. In a test database that is reused between runs, `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest` then found a background configured that is not on the faked disk, got the "background configured but not on disk" warning it forbids, and failed in all 6 cases. CI did not show it: it starts from a fresh database, and the photo test runs before this class.

The class now removes its background rows in `tearDown`, the same cleanup `RemoveBackgroundTest` and `OwnCutoutServiceTest` already do for this table. Test code only; nothing in the app changes.

Checked on the workbench, main 3861d3f6:
- Before: four rows left after `WhiteIsTheDefaultBackgroundTest`, then 6 errors in `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest`.
- After: no rows left, the photo test is green right after it.
- After: the full suite, then the photo test again on the same database, is green.

Closes #1148
params.title: WhiteIsTheDefaultBackgroundTest removes the background settings it creates
